The Soul Of The Plate

It all starts with podi.

Podi is the heart of South Indian cooking: lentils and sesame slow-roasted with red chilli and curry leaf, ground fresh and stirred into ghee or sesame oil. One spoonful turns a plain idli or a crisp dosa into something you remember.

  • Slow-roasted
  • Ground fresh
  • With ghee
  • Dosa & idli

Our Story

Rooted In Tradition. Made For Today.

Simple food, made with care.

South Indian food is about family, patience and the joy of a shared table. Podi brings that spirit to a modern setting — fresh ingredients, time-honoured recipes and a welcome that feels like home.

Whether it is a quick breakfast, a leisurely family meal or a cup of coffee with friends, every visit should feel warm and unhurried.
